recommendation.window_rule: ORB co-visibility threshold 0.40 with >= 8 new keyframes, <= 40, carry 2, cut/collapse = new window without carry: 10/11/17 windows on ME340/Sam's Club/Walmart (median 2.0/2.0/1.7 s). 0.55 and 0.70 are held by the 8-keyframe floor (13-17 windows) and changed ATE by <= 1.5 cm either way and all-facts time by <= 4 s; ORB co-visibility tracks DA3's geometric overlap (Pearson 0.92-0.97, same window counts within 2); a still camera opened no window at any threshold, a person-sized occluder crossing it opened 6 at 0.70 only (ME340).
recommendation.geometry: (b) per-window DA3 + Sim3 on the 2 carried keyframes (register_cut_shot gate, all 28 stitches passed) for the stream: first objects 6-11 s vs 15-39 s for (a), all facts 17-29 s vs 19-44 s, ATE 4.3/14.5/4.0 cm vs (a) 4.1/22.1/17.8 cm; but a collapse (whip pan) leaves no carried keyframe and splits the map (Walmart: 4 pieces, 54% of the path in the largest) and a stitch that rescales by > 10% makes places incomparable (the chain rule). Keep (a)'s per-shot DA3 as the re-join after the shot when (b) split the map. One worker per GPU (two per GPU: all facts 13-26% later, first objects 37-81% later: the GIL).
recommendation.association: position only, one to one (Hungarian): centroid within 3 sigma_pair (sigma = sqrt(0.04^2 + (0.05 z)^2) per observation) or robust-box IoU >= 0.2 (IoU 0.1-0.3 or off moves <= 6 of 1,743 objects); no appearance gate for static identity (q50 gate: +5% objects, q90: +29% objects and 249 splits); appearance only for 'moved' at the video's q99 of known-negative cosines (0.98). 2 sigma leaves 6-8 split pairs, 5 sigma merges neighbours (delivered objects covered 117 -> 101).
recommendation.change_rule: free = 5x5-minimum depth beyond the object's points by > 20% z + 2 sigma on >= 60% of judged points in >= 2 keyframes, points <= 5 m and in the inner 90% of the view, person rim +2 px, object seen on >= 3 keyframes, only across stitches whose Sim3 scales sum |log s| <= 0.1: 0 claims on 8 unplanted runs; recall is detection-limited (1 of 20 planted events).
